title: BUG: `AppTest` sidebar does not clean widgets if not rendered in the last run of the script
body:
### Checklist

- [X] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar issues.
- [X] I added a very descriptive title to this issue.
- [X] I have provided sufficient information below to help reproduce this issue.

### Summary

App script

```py
"""login.py"""
import streamlit as st

if "logged_in" not in st.session_state:
    st.session_state.logged_in = False
if "username" not in st.session_state:
    st.session_state.username = None

st.title("A Well-Tested App! :scientist:")

if not st.session_state.logged_in:
    with st.form("login_form"):
        st.session_state.username = st.text_input("Username")
        password = st.text_input("Password", type="password")
        if st.form_submit_button(
            "Login",
            use_container_width=True,
            type="primary",
            icon=":material/login:",
        ):
            if st.session_state.username == "johndoe" and password == "password123":
                st.session_state.logged_in = True
                st.rerun()
            else:
                st.error(
                    "Login failed. Incorrect username/password.",
                    icon=":material/lock:",
                )

else:
    st.success(
        f"Logged in as {st.session_state.username}",
        icon=":material/lock_open:",
    )
    with st.sidebar:
        if st.button(
            "Logout",
            icon=":material/logout:",
            use_container_width=True,
        ):
            st.session_state.logged_in = False
            st.session_state.username = None
            st.rerun()
```            


### Reproducible Code Example

```Python
from streamlit.testing.v1 import AppTest

at = AppTest.from_file("login.py").run()

print("Sidebar before login:\n", at.sidebar)

at.text_input[0].set_value("johndoe").run()
at.text_input[1].set_value("password123").run()
at.button[0].click().run()

# at.session_state.logged_in = True
# at.run()

print("Sidebar after login:\n", at.sidebar)

at.sidebar.button[0].click().run()

print("Sidebar after logout:\n", at.sidebar)
```


### Steps To Reproduce

1. Create an app using the `login.py` file provided
2. Test it using the code in the reproducible code example
3. There should be no button in the sidebar after logging out as it is only created if `session_state.logged_in == True`
4. However, according to the tests, the button still exists in the sidebar, although it is not visible in the App UI

### Expected Behavior

```
Sidebar before login:
 SpecialBlock(
    type='sidebar'
)
Sidebar after login:
 SpecialBlock(
    type='sidebar',
    children={
        0: Button(label='Logout')
    }
)
Sidebar after logout:
 SpecialBlock(
    type='sidebar'
)
```

### Current Behavior

```
Sidebar before login:
 SpecialBlock(
    type='sidebar'
)
Sidebar after login:
 SpecialBlock(
    type='sidebar',
    children={
        0: Button(label='Logout')
    }
)
Sidebar after logout:
 SpecialBlock(
    type='sidebar',
    children={
        0: Button(label='Logout')
    }
)
```

### Is this a regression?

- [ ] Yes, this used to work in a previous version.

### Debug info

- Streamlit version: 1.40.0
- Python version: 3.10.11
- Operating System: Windows11
- Browser: NA


### Additional Information

https://siddhantsadangi.slack.com/archives/C03BGMVBD5L/p1730798201368119
